rollbackRule: Generated projections, audits, optimization scripts, restore/write-back mechanisms and deployment hardening may read or enrich these facts but must not replace, erase, downgrade or reinterpret them with an older semantic state. After machine projection generation, the protected overlay must preserve external-photography-evidence.json, press-institutional-evidence.json, featured-work-peter-magyar.json, media-usage.json, media-usage-pdf-archive-2026-03-04.json and social-reuse-evidence.json as distinct canonical evidence layers, preserve authorship/privacy/relationship/political-neutrality guardrails, preserve the Q124488292 image linkage, and reject ‘Professional Photography Team’ as a standalone brand value.
